title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30359: add Direction parameter to OnBeforeScheduleRoutingLine
summary: The OnBeforeScheduleRoutingLine event now exposes a var Direction parameter so extensions can read and modify the scheduling direction for production order routing lines.
key_points: Direction parameter added as a var to OnBeforeScheduleRoutingLine event
Allows subscribers to influence starting and ending datetime calculations
Extensions can change routing behavior without modifying base logic
Enables forward or backward scheduling direction adjustment
